create.name: Max Strom
create.bio:
Max Strom is an American breathwork and yoga teacher, speaker and author who now lives and works in the Netherlands, teaching in English. For more than thirty years he has taught people to use patterns of breathing, together with gentle movement and reflection, to calm the nervous system, ease anxiety and sleeplessness, work through grief and live with more meaning. His method is called Breathe to Heal, and his Inner Axis system pairs breath-led movement with that work.

He is best known for his talks: he has spoken four times at TEDx events, and his 2015 TEDx talk on breathing has been watched more than four million times. He has also spoken at the World Government Summit in Dubai, the Mindful Leadership Summit in Washington and conferences in Amsterdam. His books are A Life Worth Breathing, which many breath and movement trainings set as reading, and There is No App for Happiness, about finding purpose in a digital age. Each year he leads workshops, immersions and retreats with hosts across Europe and beyond, trains teachers and facilitators in his method, and offers online courses and private sessions over video.

courses.title: Spring Retreat Italy – Breathe Into Wellbeing
courses.description: A seven-day residential retreat at the Mandali centre above Lake Orta in northern Italy, with breathing patterns, gentle movement, talks on personal direction and time for questions and self-enquiry. It aims at deep rest, less stress and better sleep, with vegetarian meals included in the stay.
courses.price: Tuition €690 (€552 for Inner Axis graduates); accommodation booked with Mandali

courses.title: 30 Days – From Breathing to Being
courses.description: A month of daily emails, each carrying a quote, a short breathing exercise or task, or a journaling question. The aim is a steady daily breath practice and a gentler rhythm of life, ending with a personal guide to living with meaning.

courses.title: Discover Your Life Purpose
courses.description: Six half-hour online sessions, each mixing a talk, breathing practice and writing, released one a day or saved for a home retreat. They work through self-sabotage, meaning and success to help each person name what they want to do with their life.

courses.title: Private Coaching with Max Strom
courses.description: Confidential one-to-one video sessions combining breathing patterns, gentle movement and practical guidance for people facing anxiety, panic, ongoing stress, poor sleep or grief. Each session is shaped around the person's own circumstances.
